description: Scope dimension = the compression ladder. 中鱼升级 is the substrate (OVERALL, no clipping); each lower design level is a projection with strictly smaller scope. Scope is orthogonal to Hierarchy (progressive disclosure) and View (current granularity), and is applied as a native style pass on the SAME single cell per node — no duplicated instances.

classes.ACTIVE: 该版本真正实现 / 修改
classes.BOUNDARY: 该版本依赖、消费或输出到这里，但不负责其内部实现
classes.OUT: 总体系统存在，但该版本不处理 — 置灰，不隐藏

containerRule: Presentation convention (ours, not an authority claim): a container node (SYS / IO / WAIST / WHO / WHO.SPATIAL / WHO.INTERACTION / RESOLVE) takes ACTIVE if any descendant is ACTIVE, else BOUNDARY if any descendant is BOUNDARY, else OUT. Applied below and listed explicitly so readers can audit it.

scopes.label: OVERALL｜中鱼升级
scopes.comment: 第一性主干，不做范围裁剪、不置灰。所有下级版本都是它的投影。

scopes.label: 0.3.4.0-B｜当前版本投影
scopes.basis: 中鱼0.3.4.0-B｜开发需求 R0 · 固定模板分层烘焙 · Authoring & Resolve Contract R0 (2026-09-17 读)
scopes.basisNote: 本版只闭合『属性编辑器 → Fixed Template 条件开关 / Resolve → Bake』；无 Response / Routing / Quality Selection / 动态 Fish Condition。B 的 per-CORE-condition GatePolicy 与第一性主干里的 Structural Gate 是不同对象，故 SP.GATE 记为 OUT。B 的 Time Period 直接进 Opportunity Fit，在第一性主干上落在哪一槽位尚未由权威闭合，见 SEMANTIC_OPEN。
